name: qlrisk_price_margin_loan
title: Price a MarginLoan
description:
Price one Margin Loan (Securities-Based Lending) (qlrisk MarginLoan).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, terms, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, is_lender, day_count.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 1,000,000.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
